ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Child Process Of AddinUtil.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uncommon child processes of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe) which could be a sign of potential abuse of the binary to proxy execution via a custom Addins.Store payload.

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\addinutil\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\conhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\werfault\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\werfault\\\.exe$")))
